label: The model
subgoals: Raise the yield to the power one minus the coverage
Subtract the result from one for the defect level
Multiply by one million for DPPM

label: Coverage for a target
subgoals: Convert the DPPM target to a fraction
Divide the log of one minus the defect level by the log of the yield
Subtract from one for the required coverage

label: Connecting to defect density
subgoals: Compute the yield as e to the minus area times defect density
Scale the exponent by the untested fraction
Question the model when defects do not behave like modeled faults
